page_title: CEL 3-1 ELC | Celta Vigo v Elche 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' High and wide! Lucas Cepeda (Elche) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Elche can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul after John Donald (Elche) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
89' Lucas Cepeda (Elche) commits a rough foul. Ricardo De Burgos stops the game and makes a call.
88' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
87' Josan (Elche) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
85' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Williot Swedberg tees up Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Matias Dituro.
83' Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Ricardo De Burgos had an easy-decision to make.
82' 2 - 1 Goal! Andre Silva (Elche) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ionut Radu into the bottom right corner.
82' Andre Silva (Elche) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
81' The referee blows his whistle as Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in his challenge. PENALTY! One of the players from Elche is about to take a penalty kick.
78' That will be all from Alvaro Nunez (Celta Vigo) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Oscar Mingueza.
77' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Cepeda (Elche) replacing Marc Aguado.
76' Andre Silva (Elche) was too forceful with his tackle and Ricardo De Burgos interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
72' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Elche was in an offside position.
71' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Alvarez is given a rest as he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
71' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Ferran Jutgla will be replaced by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).

70' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Matias Dituro makes a great save to stop his effort. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
69' Here is a change. Adria Pedrosa is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Josan (Elche).
69' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a change. Hector Fort (Elche) replaces Tete Morente.
69' Victor Chust (Elche) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
66' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:11.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) will replace Iago Aspas.
62' The attendance for today's match is 15401.
61' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
60' Tete Morente (Elche) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
58' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Gonzalo Villar and he is replaced by Martim Neto (Elche).
58' The substitution is prepared. Victor Chust (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing David Affengruber.
57' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
56' Elche seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
54' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is able to continue to play.
53' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
53' A cross from the by-line finds Tete Morente (Elche) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
50' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matias Dituro, who smothers the ball.
49' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

49' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Claudio Giraldez makes a half-time substitution. Manuel Fernandez comes on in place of Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo).
46' Referee Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A decent save by Ionut Radu. Andre Silva (Elche) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
45+1' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' John Donald (Elche) makes a rough challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.

43' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
42' Andre Silva (Elche) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
41' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
41' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
40' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Elche players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
37' A cross is whipped in towards John Donald (Elche) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.
36' It looks like Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) saw red with that tackle. Ricardo De Burgos won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
35' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
34' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
32' David Affengruber (Elche) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
32' Elche force their opponents to concede a corner.

30' 2 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) and Ferran Jutgla gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 2:0.
29' The game is interrupted. Andre Silva (Elche) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
28' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Gonzalo Villar (Elche) for his blatant foul.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Elche have a free kick.
25' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.

22' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo De Burgos with no other option than to blow for a foul.
21' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
19' 42:58 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' 1 - 0 It's 1:0! Javier Rueda feeds Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the left side of the net.
11' Gonzalo Villar (Elche) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
9' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after dangerous play.
8' Marc Aguado (Elche) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Ricardo De Burgos stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
5' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul.

5' Marc Aguado (Elche) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
3' Andre Silva (Elche) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Ionut Radu was alert and made a comfortable save.
2' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Elche will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' Andre Silva (Elche) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
